summary: East kerb along a sports field, cars parked beside it, homes across the road.

drivers.seclusion: Playing field and trees on the van's side; homes are across the street, 18 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, no signs; cars park along the east kerb so a van fits in the row.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street off a main road at the south end; light local traffic.
drivers.convention: A line of cars parked along the east kerb in the Esri image; no signs mapped.

flags: Low-lying: about 2.5 m elevation, flood-prone ground
Main road noise near the south end
Homes about 18-19 m across the road
sun_shade: Tree row along the kerb shades the section from the east and afternoon; open field beyond gives morning sun in gaps.

best_section.where: Munro Street east kerb, beside the sports field and tree row
